cycle.strokeCaveat: R02 outside cylinder/guide assembly is aligned to axle height; exact analytic travel equals documented 26-inch stroke. Placement and rod length are still explicit design candidates.

blockers.reason: The source has both outside cranks in the same top pose. It provides no verified A4 side/inside phase relation. This candidate keeps that reference and must not be described as historical A4 timing.

A new 0.42 m native hidden extension stays inside the source cylinder axial envelope throughout the stroke and preserves the original rod. Source cylinder caps have no gland bore, no internal piston head or real working bore; intended rod penetration through the cap is declared, not counted as free-clearance proof.

Return crank/eccentric/expansion-link/die-block/radius/union/combination/reverser joints have no consistent solved source loop. They retain the source pose; moving wheel/crosshead attachment gaps are explicitly reported.

Inside cylinder, piston and slidebar directions are not collinear in the source. Actual inner crank phase and usable slide constraint remain unresolved. Crank webs and inside rod are not independently spun.
No verified three-cylinder valve constraint graph or complete fulcrum topology exists; no decorative valve animation is substituted.

Fixed-axle, stationary rig only. Carrying/tender/coach wheel rolling, translation along rail, buffers, drawgear, brake actuation, suspension loads, forces and compliance are not actuated or validated.
